questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to ﬁll in the blank and make a meaningful sentence.**

His old car ______ on the highway.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**broke down**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• '**Broke down**' is the correct phrase that means to stop working.

 
 
• **Example**- The school bus **broke down** and had to be towed to the nearest garage. 
 
 
 
• **Broke out**- (break out) means to start suddenly.
 
 
• **Example**- The crowd** broke out** in hearty laughter.
 
 
 
• **Broke in**- (break in) means to enter a building by force, especially in order to steal things.
 
 
• **Example**- A burglar **broke in** while he was asleep.
 
 
 
• **Broke up**- (break up) to end or finish.
 
 
• **Example**- The police **broke up** the fight. 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.

questions.solution:

Let's check each option one by one.

⇒ 6 × __**3 ÷ 5**__ – 15 + 4 = 9

⇒ __**6 × 0.6**__ – 15 + 4 = 9

⇒ __**3.**____**6**__ – 15 __**+ 4**__ = 9

⇒ __7.6____** – 15**__ = 9

⇒ 7.4 ≠ 9

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) **– and ÷**

Given: 6 ÷ 3 × 5 – 15 + 4 = 9

After interchanging the symbols we get;

⇒ 6 - __**3 × 5 ÷ 15**__ + 4 = 9

⇒ __**6**__ - 1 __**+ 4**__ = 9

⇒ __10 - 1__ = 9 

⇒ **9** = 9

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 3) ÷ and +

Given: 6 ÷ 3 × 5 – 15 + 4 = 9

After interchanging the symbols we get;

⇒ 6 + 3 × 5 – __**15 ÷ 4**__ = 9

⇒ 6 + __**3 × 5**__ – 3.75 = 9

⇒ __**6 + 15**__ – 3.75 = 9

⇒ __21** – 3.75**__ = 9

⇒ 17.25 ≠ 9

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) + and –

Given: 6 ÷ 3 × 5 – 15 + 4 = 9 

After interchanging the symbols we get;

⇒ __**6 ÷ 3**__ × 5 + 15 - 4 = 9

⇒ __**2 × 5**__ + 15 - 4 = 9

⇒ __**10 + 15**__ - 4 = 9

⇒ __25** - 4**__ = 9

⇒ 21 ≠ 9

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
